arguments.message:
Sure! To re‑enrol your two‑factor authentication:

1. Open the app and go to **Settings → Security → Two‑factor authentication**.
2. Tap **Reset**.
3. Follow the first‑time setup steps: scan the new QR code with your authenticator app and enter the six‑digit code it generates.
4. Save the recovery codes that appear – they’re the only way back in if you lose the device again.

Re‑enrolling will invalidate the old QR code, so only the new one will work from now on.
